shared_or_similar_visual_information: A curved auxiliary stroke rendered with dashes or as a compass arc.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The occluded rear portion of a circular base rim in a solid drawing. Right image: A construction arc used to mark or locate a point within a planar geometric construction.
Rationales: The rear rim continues a three-dimensional circular edge behind the near surface. The compass-style arc belongs to a planar construction and locates a geometric position.
